note: Topic-to-site routing table. Powers find_site_for_topic(topic) and the network search router. 'primary' is the canonical destination for a topic; 'supporting' sites cover it from a different angle. 'aliases' are matched case-insensitively against user queries. 'canonicalUrl' names the single best page for a topic when one exists.

topics.label: Open Lakehouse
topics.summary: An open lakehouse is a data architecture that stores data in open file and table formats on commodity object storage, so that any compliant engine can read and write it without vendor lock-in.
books: The Open Source Lakehouse: Architecting the Decoupled Analytical Foundation
The 2026 Guide to Lakehouses, Apache Iceberg and Agentic AI

topics.label: Apache Iceberg
topics.summary: Apache Iceberg is an open table format that adds ACID transactions, schema evolution, and time travel to files stored in object storage.
books: Apache Iceberg: The Definitive Guide
Architecting an Apache Iceberg Lakehouse
The Book on Using Apache Iceberg with Python
topics.trademarkNote: Apache Iceberg is a trademark of the Apache Software Foundation. Referenced descriptively; no site in this network is affiliated with or endorsed by the ASF.

topics.label: Apache Polaris
topics.summary: Apache Polaris is an open catalog for Apache Iceberg that handles table discovery, access control, credential vending, and multi-engine governance.
books: Apache Polaris: The Definitive Guide
topics.trademarkNote: Apache Polaris is a trademark of the Apache Software Foundation. Referenced descriptively only.

topics.label: Iceberg Catalogs
topics.summary: The catalog is the layer that tracks table metadata, enforces access control, and lets multiple engines share the same tables safely.
books: Apache Polaris: The Definitive Guide

topics.label: Apache Parquet
topics.summary: Apache Parquet is an open columnar storage file format optimized for analytical queries.
topics.trademarkNote: Apache Parquet is a trademark of the Apache Software Foundation. Referenced descriptively only.

topics.label: Apache Arrow
topics.summary: Apache Arrow is an open in-memory columnar format that lets systems exchange data without serialization overhead.
topics.trademarkNote: Apache Arrow is a trademark of the Apache Software Foundation. Referenced descriptively only.

topics.label: Semantic Layer
topics.summary: A semantic layer maps physical tables to business concepts and governed metrics, so people and agents query meaning rather than raw schemas.
books: Constructing Context and Semantics for AI Agents

topics.label: Query Federation
topics.summary: Query federation lets a single query span multiple data sources without physically consolidating the data first.

topics.label: Agentic Analytics
topics.summary: Agentic analytics is the practice of letting AI agents discover, query, and reason over governed data with the same controls applied to human users.
books: The Book on Agentic Analytics
Enabling Agentic Analytics with Apache Iceberg and Dremio
Using AI Agents for Data Engineering and Data Analysis

topics.label: Agent Infrastructure
topics.summary: Agent infrastructure is the layer beneath an AI agent: the harness that runs it, the memory it keeps, the context it assembles, the identity and approvals that govern it, and the observability that makes it auditable.
books: Building Knowledge Systems for AI: Graphs, RAG, Memory, and Context
AI Application Architecture: Patterns for Building Intelligent Systems
Shipping AI: From Prototype to Production Systems

topics.label: Model Context Protocol
topics.summary: The Model Context Protocol is an open standard for exposing tools and data to AI agents through a consistent interface.

topics.label: Data Engineering
topics.summary: Data engineering covers the design and operation of the systems that move, model, and serve data for analysis.

topics.label: AI-Ready Data
topics.summary: AI-ready data is data prepared, governed, and described well enough that language models and agents can use it reliably.
books: AI-Ready Data
Building Knowledge Systems for AI: Graphs, RAG, Memory, and Context
Constructing Context and Semantics for AI Agents

topics.label: Open Agentic Platform
topics.summary: An open agentic platform is an architecture in which data, models, execution, and interoperability remain independently understandable and replaceable. It is a stack of four layers rather than a mandatory suite: data and semantics, models and routing, harnesses and brokers, and open standards.
books: The Book on Agentic Analytics
AI Application Architecture: Patterns for Building Intelligent Systems

topics.label: Open Agent Standards
topics.summary: Open agent standards make skills, tool connections, agent identity, and work plans portable between runtimes. Agent Skills package capability, the Model Context Protocol carries tool access, the Open Agent Profile describes who an agent is and what it has learned, and the Agentic Graph Specification describes the shape of a piece of work.

topics.label: Agent Governance
topics.summary: Agent governance is the practice of enforcing what an agent may do outside the model rather than requesting it in a prompt: scoped capability and credentials, approval gates on irreversible actions, delegated identity, and records complete enough to reconstruct what happened months later.
books: Governing AI Systems
Evaluating AI Systems: Testing LLMs, RAG, and Agents
